title: 中国早餐宇宙①上海四大金刚：一顿早饭，吵了半世纪 | Shanghai's Big Four Breakfast 🥢
description:
你的城市，早饭第一口是什么？评论区告诉我。

【中国早餐宇宙·第1集 上海】大饼、油条、粢饭、豆浆——上海人叫它「四大金刚」，为哪四样最正宗，能吵上大半个世纪。大饼分甜咸，油条要空心酥脆，粢饭用糯米裹住油条，豆浆也分甜咸党。这套组合从晚清民国的移民味道里长出来，1936 年的报纸就写过清晨六到八点排队买大饼油条的盛况；「四大金刚」这个名字借自佛教的四大天王，八十年代才叫响。便宜、烫嘴、顶饱，是一座城市醒来的第一口。

Shanghai's classic breakfast quartet — flatbread, fried dough stick, sticky-rice roll and soy milk — is nicknamed the "Four Heavenly Kings." Locals have argued for half a century over which version is truly authentic. The set grew out of migrant food cultures after the port opened; a 1936 newspaper already described dawn queues, and the Buddhist "Four Kings" nickname caught on in the 1980s. Cheap, piping hot and filling — a city's first bite of the day.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food folklore, not dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
